note: The Research menu, as the estate means it. Written 12 November 2026 when the Investigations and Evidence menus became one Research tab (David's decision, the Defranceski trial, TheDefranceski PR #4, then seven archives). It replaces data/evidence-menu.json as the canon an archive is checked against; the eight core pages, their routes and their labels are the Evidence canon's, unchanged. What is new: the core pages are READ IN THE ORDER OF THE THREE GROUPS (To do: open-questions, errands, worklist; What's new: searched, corrections, changes; Sources & method: sources, method), and an archive's own pages (deep dives, the registers and places the Atlas also carries, a Checks group) may stand in the same menu, so they are reported as local and are not a departure. A menu label is estate-wide so a reader learns it once; a page TITLE may stay the archive's own voice.

folds.note: Pages that do the same job as a core page under another name, where the fold is MECHANICAL: a list that does a core page's job. Each fold keeps its old route working. Folded on 9 October 2026: Photograph these (Lerena, Blazevic, Defranceski), The Letters (Booyzen), What we cannot close (Lerena, Defranceski), the research log (Booyzen into What changed, Defranceski into Open Questions), and Luwinski's Letters out, Research log and Bounded negatives into its Errands, What changed and What has been read pages. READ AND DELIBERATELY NOT FOLDS, because each is an argued dossier or a different object, not a list: Lerena's Hypotheses and Roadmap, Mazza's The Audit, Booyzen's Disputed (its own dossiers.py records that it concerns contested facts about people), Luwinski's Status (a dated snapshot whose items mostly are not work-list rows) and Falco's Research log (an index of its working-notes files). 'Research log' turned out to be FOUR different things across four archives: the same log.json as What changed (Booyzen), a second view of the open questions (Defranceski), an index of working notes (Falco) and a chronology (Luwinski), which is why the fold table cannot name it.
